# Router-name: github_discussions  
**Commit time:** 2026.08.11  
**Cookies?:** no  
**Author:** AI转写 / huiinyg-rusting审核 - 来源于RSShub@waynzh  
**Introduction:** GitHub 仓库 Discussion 讨论列表 (GraphQL)  
**Address:** rssust://github_discussions  
**Example:** [rssust://github_discussions?owner=community&repo=discussions](/github_discussions?owner=community&repo=discussions)  
**Parameter:**  
1. **owner**  
   Type of parameter: string  
   Default value: 无  
   Meaning: 仓库所有者 (必填)  
2. **repo**  
   Type of parameter: string  
   Default value: 无  
   Meaning: 仓库名 (必填)  
3. **state**  
   Type of parameter: string  
   Default value: open  
   Meaning: 状态, open/closed/answered/unanswered/locked/unlocked/all  
4. **category**  
   Type of parameter: string  
   Default value: 无  
   Meaning: 讨论分类名 (可选)  
5. **limit**  
   Type of parameter: number  
   Default value: 20  
   Meaning: 条数, 最大 100
